notes:
v0.6.32: fix tr | head SIGPIPE in bootstrap script (temp file).

The v0.6.31 fix (LC_ALL=C prefix) didn't actually work in the
script's set -euo pipefail context. The proper fix is to
avoid the pipeline entirely:

  head -c 64 /dev/urandom > /tmp/.novnc-pw.buf
  NOVNC_PASSWORD=$(tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 < /tmp/.novnc-pw.buf | head -c 8)
  rm /tmp/.novnc-pw.buf

The first head -c 64 returns cleanly (64 bytes read, no SIGPIPE
because /dev/urandom never blocks and the read completes).
The second pipeline has tr reading from a finite file (the
temp file) so it never gets SIGPIPE on EOF.

This is the same family of bug as the apt-cache SIGPIPE from
v0.6.23. The pattern: any pipeline where the consumer closes
before the producer is done will fail under pipefail when the
producer is non-blocking (urandom, apt-cache, large logs).
Solution: write to a temp file first.
